lines.text: The writer says he received the gospel by revelation from Jesus Christ, not from any man.
In Judaism the writer severely persecuted the church of God and was extremely zealous for the traditions of his fathers.
God revealed His Son in the writer for the Gentiles, and he went into Egypt and later returned to Damascus.
The writer went to Syria and Cilicia, and Judea's churches, who only heard about him, glorified God because of him.
